// Classifier fixture, vitest: CONDITIONAL-ONLY, the CONDITIONAL and GUARDED-RETURN flags, and
// their negatives. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

describe("conditional", () => {
  it("parses the year", () => {
    const result = parse("2024");
    if (result.ok) {
      expect(result.value.year).toBe(2024);
    }
  });

  it("creates the asset", () => {
    const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    expect(result.value.kind).toBe("image");
  });

  it("reports the load error", async () => {
    try {
      await load();
    } catch (error) {
      expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(LoadError);
    }
  });

  it("creates the asset after asserting success", () => {
    const result = MediaAsset.create(input);
    expect(result.ok).toBe(true);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    expect(result.value.kind).toBe("image");
  });

  it("parses the year after asserting success", () => {
    const result = parse("2024");
    expect(result.ok).toBeTruthy();
    if (result.ok) {
      expect(result.value.year).toBe(2024);
    }
  });
});
